capabilities: Preview articles with WeChat-style CSS themes
Publish drafts to WeChat via its API
Copy formatted HTML with inline CSS
Render LaTeX formulas and callout blocks
disambiguation: Despite the generic name, it publishes only to WeChat Official Accounts (微信公众号), not to blogs or other platforms.
extras: Setup requires adding your IP to the WeChat MP Platform whitelist; custom themes live in a custom/ folder and a separate CSS Theme Guide is referenced.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to style notes with the inline-CSS formatting WeChat requires or to publish them to a WeChat Official Account.

requires.name: WeChat MP Platform AppID and AppSecret

summary: WeChat Official Account publisher for Obsidian with CSS-themed preview, one-click copy, and API draft publishing.
